//: MarwanOS broker - package manifest for the 'install' verb.
The broker performs four verbs: install, updates.install, wifi.forget, bt.forget.
Only 'install' consults this file - the other three take no manifest entry (and,
like install, no path, URL, command line or argument list from the caller).
For 'install' this file is the ONLY authority the broker has. A request from the
shell carries an 'id' from this file and nothing else - never a URL, a path, or an
argument. Everything that gets downloaded or executed is named here, by an
administrator.
Deployed to C:\ProgramData\MarwanOS\packages.json, writable by administrators only.
The worker refuses to run if that stops being true.
Fields:
id           required. Slug the shell asks for. [a-z0-9._-], max 64 chars.
name         required. Human label for logs and the shell UI.
url          https:// only. The installer to fetch.
path         alternative to url: an installer that is ALREADY on this machine,
absolute, may end in a *.exe glob (newest match). For setups another
program downloads and then wants run elevated. Publisher pin required;
the file is copied into the broker cache before it is verified and run.
publisher    required with url or path. Substring that MUST appear in the file's
Authenticode signer subject. The signature must also be Valid. This
is the provenance pin - it survives vendor version bumps, which a
sha256 pin does not.
sha256       optional. Exact content pin. Use for installers that never change.
When present it is enforced IN ADDITION to the publisher check.
type         'exe' (default) or 'msi'.
args         argument array passed to the installer. Silent switches go here.
For msi the worker supplies /i /qn /norestart itself.
interactive  optional. true = the installer needs a person AND an elevated token
at once (Riot: sign in, install the game, and its elevated agent puts
Vanguard in without a UAC prompt). The worker starts it INSIDE the
console session, visible on the console, under the CONSOLE USER's own
admin token (lowered to Medium integrity where UAC elevates admins
silently, so the shell's pad-pointer can drive it) - or as SYSTEM when
the console user has no admin token. It then waits until every postKill
process left by the install is closed before judging the ticket.
verifyPath   optional. Path that must exist afterwards for the install to be
reported OK, regardless of the installer's exit code.
postKill     optional. Process NAMES the worker stops after the installer exits.
Only processes that came out of THIS install are touched - the ones in
the installer's job object, or (for the SYSTEM fallback) SYSTEM-owned.
The player's own copy of the same program is never killed. Names, not paths.
wingetId     optional. If winget is present it is preferred over url. This
image has no winget, so it is unused here - kept so the same
manifest works on the laptop.
Adding an entry is a decision to let the console shell install that software
with nobody at the machine. Adding a wildcard, a caller-supplied url, or a
'skip verification' flag would hand marwanshell the box. Don't. The same goes
for adding a verb to the worker that takes a path, a url or a command line.
